name: feature.profiles.nodes
description: Profiles feature node pack — reads over ctx.features.profiles (ADR 0172 / ADR 0624 / ADR 0888): list/get the profiles the run's acting user may see (their home tenant, or the people who shared their profile with the run's workspace) as capability projections (no bio, contact or asset tokens). A run with no acting user, an API key, a disabled user or a non-member is a typed forbidden_scope failure. get takes { userId } and answers { profile, found } (an empty id is a typed validation_error failure; an id outside the reader's directory is found:false). role:action (recorded).
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Profiles: List
nodes.description: Lists the profiles the run's acting user may see over ctx.features.profiles.listProfiles (ADR 0888: home tenant, or the workspace's opted-in members). Output: { profiles, truncated? }. A run without a signed-in member is a typed forbidden_scope failure.

nodes.label: Profiles: Get
nodes.description: Reads one profile the run's acting user may see over ctx.features.profiles.getProfile. Inputs: { userId } (an opaque user:<id> in the reader's home tenant, or a person who shared their profile with the run's workspace — ADR 0888). Output: { profile|null, found } as a capability projection (no bio, contact or asset tokens). An empty/absent userId is a typed validation_error node FAILURE; a run without a signed-in member is a typed forbidden_scope failure; an id outside the reader's directory is { profile: null, found: false } so a chain branches on { falsy found }.
